notes: id is null: this mining-site class has no ID and no table of its own anywhere in docs/. A stable-ID decision is required before docs/technical/40-content-data-and-validation.md:67 ("Reuse accepted gameplay IDs exactly") can be satisfied; minting one is a boundary decision, not a transcription choice.
Field names other than the survey-state table (docs/40-mining-and-extraction.md:82-86) are derived from prose.
extractionZoneRadiusMeters is null: docs/40-mining-and-extraction.md:48 states "Exact radius and any resource-specific size variation remain open."
resonanceField.radiusMeters is null: docs/40-mining-and-extraction.md:100 states only that the field is "larger than its extraction zone"; no dimension is given.

The per-material resonance effect names and texts live in the resource catalog (docs/40-mining-and-extraction.md:102-109 duplicated at docs/61-specialized-resource-identities.md:94) and are not duplicated here.
Arithmetic check: 4 present materials x 8-10 geodes = 32-40 geodes per map, matching the stated "A standard map therefore contains 32–40 material geodes" (docs/40-mining-and-extraction.md:88).
commonOreFromCompletionJackpotsPerMap 1600-2000 is stated at docs/50-maps-resources-and-navigation.md:22 and docs/60-resources-crafting-progression.md:49 and equals 32-40 geodes x 50 ore.

presentation, map marker, and spawn exclusions (required by docs/technical/40-content-data-and-validation.md:140) are not specified for this class in the gameplay docs; placement guarantees are transcribed in content/maps/standard-map-generation-contract.json.

abundanceStates.meaning: Lowest accepted supply; still broadly plentiful

surveyDisclosure: The geological survey reports both the abundance label and detected geode count, but not their locations.

completionPayout.detail: exactly one unit of the geode's own material

partialPayout: none; no partial material or ore payout

progressDecay.rule: The reward is withheld until the Complete transition, so an incomplete attempt pays nothing.

resonanceField.generationConstraint: Standard map generation separates unopened geodes far enough that their resonance fields do not overlap.

depletedState: non-interactive mapped landmark for the rest of the run; cannot be reactivated
persistence: run-local; the specialized material and 50 common ore are lost if unspent when the run ends
